Name: My Crowns
Author: Adalghizar
Description:
Some new crowns and space helmets. Some are purchased at the Hat Shop after certain conditions. Others are crafted at the sewing machine. They also have buffs.  Some of these new crowns and helmets are part of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27627]Outfit Buffs[/url].

A comprehensive list of all the buffs and price changes for my mods can be found here:
